capabilities: Show per-folder counts of notes, files, words or file sizes in the file explorer
Filter what is counted by extension list, inclusions or wildcard exclusions
Show a vault-wide total in the status bar
Import settings from File Explorer Note Count
Restyle the count badges with a CSS snippet
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It copies settings from File Explorer Note Count on first run, and the author warns to turn the old plugin off to avoid double numbers.
intentEvidence: This plugin does what File Explorer Note Count does and adds excluded folders, direct-only counts, hiding zeros
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows only folder names, so there is no way to see at a glance how many notes or files each folder holds.

relations.evidence: This plugin does what File Explorer Note Count does and adds excluded folders, direct-only counts

summary: File explorer enhancement that shows note, file, word or size counts next to each folder, updating live as files change.
